$comment: RTI workflow documentation. Edit this file to add/remove flows or nodes; the page reloads it via fetch(). IDs in flow steps must match a package id below.

packages.description: App lifecycle, launch sequence, registers commands and singletons.
Carbon hotkey registration. Maps keyCode+mods to RTICommand.
Command definition (action, hotkey, modifiers). Built by CommandBuilder.
Owns overlay + user panel windows; reconciles UserPanelStore changes.
Menubar status item + dynamic menu items.
Per-session capture orchestrator. Wires AVAudioEngine tap to SonioxClient.
AVAudioEngine input tap, 16 kHz mono PCM.
Writes raw PCM to disk for archival / file-mode reuse.
WebSocket streaming transcription. Emits interim + final SonioxWord callbacks.
Soniox REST file API for imported audio/video. Upload → create job → poll.
SCScreenshotManager capture, then OCR. Image discarded after.
Vision text recognition.
Recording lifecycle. Owns AudioPipeline, dispatches Soniox words, coordinates session finalisation.
Per-channel turn aggregation; commits finals to JSONL + LiveSessionStore.
Generates session title from transcript via one LLMRequest.
Generates structured meeting summary (LLMRequest, smart model).
Generates session themes (low-fi during, hi-fi at finalise).
Drag-to-import queue. Transcodes via AVAssetReader, sends to Soniox file mode, writes corpus.
Per-session Q&A. Subclasses CorpusChatController; full transcript injected as system context.
Cross-corpus Q&A. Calls HybridRetriever then streams via base controller.
Base class shared by Ask/Project/Session Q&A — streaming, citations, prior-turn memory.
Persists Ask Corpus conversations as JSON files.
Reads transcript text for a session id (from JSONL or corpus).
Overlay assistant chat state, streaming orchestration, tool invocation.
One-shot async request. Used by title/summary/themes/panels controllers.
Low-level OpenAI-compatible SSE client.
Assembles system + conversation messages from PromptContext + active mode.
Streaming + tool-use loop. Emits content / reasoning / tool-call events.
Provider registry + active selection (DeepSeek default). Reads keys from KeychainStore.
Session-finalise render pipeline: writes markdown then triggers FTS + dense reindex.
Atomic markdown writes to ~/meetings/*.md (canonical record).
Rebuilds SQLite FTS5 index from markdown corpus.
Builds dense embedding index (corpus_embeddings table) via Embedder.
NLEmbedding 512-dim sentence vectors. v2 path: bge-small via MLX.
Reciprocal-rank fusion of FTS top-20 + dense top-20 sessions.
BM25 query against session_search FTS5 table; prefix tokens AND-ed.
Per-session JSONL live writer for in-progress recordings.
In-memory cache of corpus markdown (sessions, summaries).
Translates natural-language description → PanelKind + config via sub-LLM call.
Enum: counter | periodic_cards. Holds typed config for each kind.
Observable store of spawned UserPanel records.
Renders a UserPanel as a floating window (counter view or periodic cards view).
Borderless NSPanel with sharingType=.none. Hosts OverlayPanelView.
Main overlay SwiftUI view. Bound to LLMController.entries for live deltas.
Cross-corpus Q&A SwiftUI view. Calls AskCorpusController on submit.
Holds active mode + reference files. Reads/writes UserDefaults.
API key storage at ~/Library/Application Support/RTI/credentials.json (mode 0600).

flows.title: Start a recording session
flows.summary: Hotkey or menubar click → audio capture begins → Soniox WS streams words → transcript pipeline aggregates turns and commits to LiveSessionStore.

steps.label: hotkey dispatch
steps.passes: Carbon RegisterEventHotKey fires; coordinator looks up command by keyCode + modifiers and invokes its action closure.

steps.label: toggleSession()
steps.passes: Command action calls into the SessionCoordinator singleton's toggleSession entry point.

steps.label: prepare(sessionId)
steps.passes: After mic permission resolves, SessionCoordinator builds an AudioPipeline for the new session id.

steps.label: start tap
steps.passes: AVAudioEngine input tap delivers 16 kHz mono PCM buffers.

steps.label: connect + send PCM
steps.passes: Opens wss://api.soniox.com/transcribe-websocket with API key from KeychainStore; pipes PCM frames as binary websocket messages.

steps.label: onWords callback
steps.passes: Parses SonioxResponse JSON; emits SonioxWord arrays (interim is_final=false, commit is_final=true) back to the coordinator.

steps.label: process(words)
steps.passes: Routes by speaker channel (0 → self, 1+ → them_N); pipeline aggregates words into turn objects.

steps.label: writeJSONL(turn)
steps.passes: Final turns get appended to the per-session JSONL live file. Interim updates stay in memory until they finalise.

flows.title: Stop and finalise a session
flows.summary: Hotkey toggles stop → audio finalises → 1.5s drain → title + summary + themes generated in parallel → markdown rendered → FTS and dense indexes rebuilt.

steps.label: finalize()
steps.passes: Stops the AVAudioEngine tap and signals end-of-stream to Soniox.

steps.label: EOS marker
steps.passes: Sends Soniox's end-of-stream payload so the server emits any pending finals.

steps.label: generateTitle()
steps.passes: After 1.5s drain, kicks off async title generation — fed transcript text, returns a short title via one LLMRequest.

steps.label: collectAsync()
steps.passes: One non-streaming LLM call with a title-generation prompt; result is the canonical session title.

steps.label: generateSummary()
steps.passes: Async summary generation runs in parallel; uses the smart model tier.

steps.label: generateHiFi()
steps.passes: Final hi-fi themes pass replaces the streaming low-fi themes generated during recording.

steps.label: renderSession(id)
steps.passes: Once title/summary/themes resolve, the corpus manager rolls everything into a single markdown file.

steps.label: write(markdown)
steps.passes: Atomic write to ~/meetings/<title>.md — canonical record of the session.

steps.label: reindex()
steps.passes: Rebuilds the BM25 session_search FTS5 table so the new session is searchable.

steps.label: reindex()
steps.passes: Embeds new chunks via Embedder and writes them to corpus_embeddings (one row per chunk, L2-normalised Float32 BLOB).

steps.label: vector(for: chunk)
steps.passes: NLEmbedding sentence vectors per chunk; cosine becomes a plain dot product against the table at query time.

flows.title: Smart Screenshot (⌘H)
flows.summary: Hotkey captures the active display, runs OCR, attaches the text as pending screen context, and the overlay surfaces it for the next LLM turn.

steps.label: ⌘H pressed
steps.passes: Carbon hotkey lookup invokes the screenshot command's action closure.

steps.label: captureAndAttach()
steps.passes: Command delegates to the screenshot manager which orchestrates capture + analysis.

steps.label: recognizeText(image)
steps.passes: Vision framework extracts text. The raw image is never persisted — only its derived text is kept.

steps.label: attachScreenContext()
steps.passes: OCR text is stored as the LLM controller's pendingScreenContext, ready to ride along on the next user turn.

steps.label: observable update
steps.passes: OverlayPanelView observes pendingScreenContext and renders a chip showing the captured context is attached.

flows.title: Overlay assistant (⌘\)
flows.summary: Hotkey toggles the borderless overlay → user types a question → PromptBuilder assembles context (mode + screen + transcript) → ToolLoop streams SSE deltas into the view.

steps.label: ⌘\ pressed
steps.passes: Hotkey dispatch fires the toggle-overlay command.

steps.label: toggleOverlay()
steps.passes: Coordinator shows or hides the OverlayWindowController panel.

steps.label: toggle()
steps.passes: NSPanel made key + visible (sharingType=.none keeps it out of screencapture and most screen-share targets).

steps.label: sendAskAnything(text)
steps.passes: User submits the prompt; view calls into the controller singleton.

steps.label: build messages
steps.passes: Builds system messages from PromptContext (mode, glossary, project, screen ctx, transcript) and conversation messages from prior turns.

steps.label: run(messages, tools)
steps.passes: Streams SSE from the active provider; emits contentDelta / reasoningDelta / toolCall events.

steps.label: stream(request)
steps.passes: Low-level OpenAI-compatible SSE: parses data: chunks, handles [DONE] sentinel, extracts choices[].delta.content (and DeepSeek's reasoning_content).

steps.label: contentDelta event
steps.passes: Each delta append updates the streaming entry; observable change re-renders OverlayPanelView immediately.

steps.label: entries / streaming
steps.passes: View binds to llm.entries and llm.streaming so user sees tokens land character-by-character.

flows.title: Ask Your Corpus
flows.summary: Cross-session Q&A over hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense embeddings, RRF-merged). Cited sessions become clickable chips; conversation auto-persists.

steps.label: ask(question)
steps.passes: User submits query; view forwards to controller singleton via the base class entry point.

steps.label: retrieve(query)
steps.passes: Hybrid retrieval: top-20 from FTS + top-20 from dense, then RRF fusion at 1/(60+rank).

steps.label: search(prefixTokens)
steps.passes: BM25-ranked FTS5 query against session_search; tokens AND-ed; returns top sessions with best snippet.

steps.label: vector(query)
steps.passes: Embeds the query into 512-dim sentence vector for dense scoring.

steps.label: dot vs corpus_embeddings
steps.passes: Brute-force cosine (plain dot product, vectors are normalised) over corpus_embeddings rows. ~5ms at <50k chunks.

steps.label: stream(candidates)
steps.passes: Top 6 + 4 most-recent (deduped, capped at 8) sessions packaged as title + date + summary (≤1500 chars) + best snippet for the model.

steps.label: buildSystemMessages()
steps.passes: Citation-aware system prompt + last 6 turns of memory + candidate context block.

steps.label: run() streaming
steps.passes: One streaming SSE call. Controller parses [Session Title] citations from the response so only actually-cited sessions surface as chips.

steps.label: save(conversation)
steps.passes: Conversation auto-persists to ~/Library/Application Support/RTI/ask-corpus/<id>.json after each completed turn.

flows.title: Per-session Q&A
flows.summary: Scoped Q&A over a single session's transcript + summary. Subclasses CorpusChatController so streaming + citations + memory are shared with Ask Corpus.

steps.label: ask(q, sessionId)
steps.passes: Per-session Q&A surface stores the active session id and delegates to the base controller's ask().

steps.label: text(forSessionId)
steps.passes: Reads the full transcript text for the scoped session (from JSONL or rendered corpus).

steps.label: summary(forSessionId)
steps.passes: Reads cached meeting summary so the model has both the headline and the raw words.

steps.label: single candidate
steps.passes: Returns one candidate (the session itself); base prompt builder injects the full transcript directly rather than a truncated summary.

steps.label: run() streaming
steps.passes: Same streaming + citation pipeline as Ask Corpus. [Session Title] citations still work for quote extraction.

flows.title: Drag-to-import audio / video
flows.summary: Drop file into Sessions list → SessionImporter queues + transcodes via AVAssetReader → Soniox file API runs async transcription → corpus + indexes updated.

steps.label: import(urls)
steps.passes: Drop target on the sessions list / project view forwards file URLs to the importer.

steps.label: transcode → 16k WAV
steps.passes: AVAssetReader decodes the source audio/video and writes 16 kHz mono PCM as a temp WAV the Soniox file API will accept.

steps.label: transcribe(url)
steps.passes: Multipart POST uploads the WAV; second POST creates a transcription job; client polls status until done.

steps.label: final words
steps.passes: Returns the completed SonioxWord array (speaker-labelled, with timing).

steps.label: renderSession(id)
steps.passes: Same finalise pipeline as a live session: render markdown, write to ~/meetings, kick FTS + dense reindex.

steps.label: reindex()
steps.passes: Imported session becomes searchable in BM25 FTS.

steps.label: reindex()
steps.passes: Imported session's chunks added to corpus_embeddings via Embedder.

flows.title: Live transcript-driven panel spawn
flows.summary: Model decides the user wants a custom widget → tool call routes to PanelSpawner → sub-LLM resolves the description into a typed PanelKind → WindowCoordinator opens the floating panel.

steps.label: spawn_panel tool call
steps.passes: Tool result handler in the LLM controller dispatches to PanelSpawner with the user's description string.

steps.label: spawn(description)
steps.passes: Spawner is the single entry point for natural-language panel creation across the app.

steps.label: translate → JSON
steps.passes: Sub-LLM call asks for a JSON object discriminating on `kind` (counter | periodic_cards) with typed config.

steps.label: decode(JSON)
steps.passes: Parses kind + config into the PanelKind enum case (counter or periodicCards).

steps.label: add(UserPanel)
steps.passes: Inserts a UserPanel record into the observable store; this is the source of truth for which panels exist.

steps.label: observable change
steps.passes: Coordinator's reconciler observes the store and creates/destroys windows to match.

steps.label: spawn window
steps.passes: Per-panel NSPanel hosts the appropriate SwiftUI view based on PanelKind (counter view or periodic cards view).

flows.title: Switch active mode
flows.summary: User selects a Mode in Settings → ModeStore updates → next LLM turn assembles a new system prompt with the mode's reference text baked in.

steps.label: activeModeId = newId
steps.passes: UI writes the selection; ModeStore persists to UserDefaults and notifies observers.

steps.label: observable change
steps.passes: Controllers read ModeStore.activeMode lazily on the next turn — no eager rebuild.

steps.label: build with activeMode
steps.passes: PromptBuilder reads activeMode.systemPrompt + activeMode.referenceText and folds them into the system message stack ahead of context attachments.

steps.label: next turn payload
steps.passes: Next streaming request carries the new mode's prompt + reference material; subsequent turns inherit until the mode changes again.

flows.title: Change LLM provider / API key
flows.summary: Settings writes the API key to KeychainStore and updates the active provider id. The next LLMRequest reads the fresh key + base URL on demand.

steps.label: set(apiKey)
steps.passes: Settings UI writes the key to ~/Library/Application Support/RTI/credentials.json (mode 0600). Never stored in UserDefaults.

steps.label: activeId = newId
steps.passes: Provider selection persists; LLMProviders.active resolves to the matching LLMProviderConfig (DeepSeek / OpenAI / etc.).

steps.label: next turn
steps.passes: Subsequent send() builds an LLMRequest with no cached provider info — it asks LLMProviders.active fresh each time.

steps.label: config lookup
steps.passes: Resolves baseURL + model + apiKey closure; the closure reads from KeychainStore so rotated keys take effect immediately.

steps.label: apiKey closure
steps.passes: Keychain read returns the freshly-written key; LLMClient uses it for the Authorization header on the next SSE call.

steps.label: stream(request)
steps.passes: Streaming OpenAI-compatible SSE call against the new provider's base URL.
